title: Ephemeric

inlines.v: EPHEM'ERAL, EPHEM'ERIC, adjective Diurnal; beginning and ending in a day; continuing or existing one day only. 2. Short-lived; existing or continuing for a short time only. [Ephemeral is generally used. Ephemerous is not analogically formed.]
